report_name: New 'Panzer' RaaS Targets ESXi, Claims Victims in 11 Countries

threat_actors.name: Panzer
threat_actors.description: A Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) group active since August 2026, primarily targeting industrial and manufacturing sectors. The group provides affiliates with encryptors for Windows, Linux, FreeBSD, and VMware ESXi, and operates a semi-private affiliate program requiring vetting via Tox.
threat_actors.goals: Financial extortion of targeted organizations through ransomware deployment and data theft.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The primary objective of the Panzer ransomware is to encrypt files on victim systems, including entire VMware ESXi environments, for financial extortion.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: Assessed as a likely technique used by Panzer affiliates to delete volume shadow copies or backups to prevent easy recovery from the ransomware attack.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: Assessed as a likely technique for initial access and lateral movement, particularly for accessing VMware ESXi management interfaces.

attack_patterns.name: OS Credential Dumping
attack_patterns.description: Assessed as a likely technique used by Panzer affiliates to harvest credentials for lateral movement and to gain access to hypervisors.

malware.name: Panzer Ransomware
malware.description: A multi-platform ransomware provided by the Panzer RaaS operation. It has encryptor builds for Windows, Linux, FreeBSD, and a particularly dangerous variant for VMware ESXi that can encrypt multiple virtual machines.

tools.name: Tox
tools.description: The Tox messaging service is used by the Panzer RaaS group to communicate with and vet prospective affiliates.

identities.name: Doimo Cucine
identities.description: An Italian manufacturer named as an initial unconfirmed victim of the Panzer ransomware group.

identities.name: NTE Italia
identities.description: An Italian telecommunications firm named as an initial unconfirmed victim of the Panzer ransomware group.

identities.name: VMware ESXi
identities.description: A hypervisor platform specifically targeted by the Panzer ransomware, allowing attackers to encrypt multiple virtual machines at once.

infrastructure.name: Panzer RaaS Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: The RaaS platform includes a dark web portal for managing negotiations, processing cryptocurrency payments, and publishing stolen data on a leak site.

indicators.name: Panzer ESXi VM Shutdown Command
indicators.pattern:
title: Panzer Ransomware ESXi VM Shutdown Command
id: 2a9b4c1d-8e7f-4a3b-9c8d-1e2f3a4b5c6d
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of 'esxcli' to forcefully terminate virtual machine processes on a VMware ESXi host. This is a common precursor to encryption by ESXi-targeting ransomware like Panzer.
references:
  - https://industrialcyber.co/manufacturing/panzer-ransomware-targets-italian-manufacturer-as-esxi-capability-raises-industrial-security-concerns/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-10
tags:
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.t1675
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '/esxcli'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'vm'
      - 'process'
      - 'kill'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of the `esxcli` command to kill virtual machine processes, a technique used by ESXi-targeting ransomware like Panzer before encryption.

indicators.name: Panzer Ransomware File Extension
indicators.pattern:
title: Panzer Ransomware Encrypted File Detection
id: 8d7c6b5a-4f3e-4d2c-1b0a-9e8d7c6b5a4f
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of files with the '.vmdk.panzer' extension, indicating encryption activity by Panzer ransomware on VMware datastores.
references:
  - https://industrialcyber.co/manufacturing/panzer-ransomware-targets-italian-manufacturer-as-esxi-capability-raises-industrial-security-concerns/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-10
tags:
  - attack.t1486
level: critical
logsource:
  category: file_event
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.vmdk.panzer'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects files created with the `.vmdk.panzer` extension, which is indicative of Panzer ransomware encrypting VMware virtual machine disks.
